notes: NORTHBROWN 2.0.8 fixes Google Maps location binding in generated websites. Maps and Google links are rebuilt at render/export time from the Google Place ID when available, otherwise from business name, address, town and postcode. Existing projects immediately use a newly configured Maps Embed API key. Projects without enough location data no longer fall back to a whole-world embed. Includes compile checks and automatic rollback to the updater-created 2.0.7 backup on failure.
